meta.title: 궁금상자
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (궁금상자, a science channel; this episode follows one plastic bottle from the bin to a T-shirt (fictional channel, fictional data)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 궁금상자, a science channel; this episode follows one plastic bottle from the bin to a T-shirt (fictional channel, fictional data)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A sticker board: blue-grey #DCE5EC with a dot grid, every picture cut out with a thick white border and a soft shadow; one colour per station (blue #3B82F6, green #3FAE6A, purple #8B5CF6, red #EF5B4C, amber, blue again), ink #22303F for labels, a yellow badge for the channel.
rationale.type: Jua, round and friendly, for every label and caption; Gothic A1 for the chart numbers.
rationale.motion: Explainer travel: the camera glides across one big board from station to station, each sticker slaps down from 1.5x with an overshoot and a tilt, the step label follows, the dotted path grows to it; the end pulls back until the whole journey is on screen.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 112 BPM in C major on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): a recorded marimba for the motion, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel on top, a light kit; every sticker lands with a pop and a soft thud, every glide is a swish, the chart counts.
rationale.visuals: All code: each object (a bottle, a recycling bin, a truck, a sorting belt, flakes, a spool of thread, a T-shirt, the badge, a bar chart of fictional data) is drawn once into its own canvas, given a white border by stamping its silhouette round a circle, cached, and slapped onto the board in world coordinates.
rationale.narration: Optional: a short voice-over would fit, but the captions carry it without one.
